title: High lunge

steps.text: From a low lunge, tuck your back toes and lift the back knee off the mat.
steps.cue: From a low lunge, tuck your toes and lift the back knee.

steps.text: Keep the front knee above the ankle and press through the back foot.
steps.cue: Front knee over the ankle. Press the back foot.

steps.text: Reach both arms up and lengthen through the whole body.
steps.cue: Reach both arms up. Grow long.

steps.text: Hold for a few breaths, then lower the back knee and change sides.
steps.cue: Hold and breathe, then lower the back knee.
steps.say: Hold for a few breaths, then lower the back knee.

mistakes: Letting the front knee drift past the toes.
Arching the lower back to reach higher.
regression: Lower the back knee to the mat.
stopIf: Come out if your front knee hurts or you feel unsteady.

anatomy.why: The front thigh holds your weight while the front of the back hip opens.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.6 Appendicular muscles of the pelvic girdle and lower limbs
